name: comp-168
blurb: NPS-style 0-5 rating scale with emoji sentiment labels.
description: Net Promoter Score radio selector showing 0-5 scale with emoji indicators at the ends. Built on shadcn's RadioGroup.
use_when: Collecting NPS feedback or 0-10 satisfaction ratings with clear visual indicators.
avoid_when: When respondents need detailed option descriptions or more than 11 choices.
a11y: Built on accessible RadioGroup with keyboard support and focus-visible indicators. Emoji are decorative supplemental visual cues.
